evals.name: new-go-project
evals.prompt: Create the full Nix tooling for a new Go CLI project called 'shipit' (repo will be github.com/aldoborrero/shipit, standard go.mod at the root, no container image). Set it up like my other repos.
evals.trap: Open-ended 'set it up' tempts hand-rolled flake outputs, flake-utils, or forgetting git add before nix commands

assertions.text: flake.nix has exactly the four inputs (nixpkgs unstable, blueprint, treefmt-nix, devshell) with nixpkgs.follows on all three, and outputs = inputs.blueprint { inherit inputs; prefix = "nix"; }
Creates nix/devshell.nix (numtide devshell) with just, perSystem.self.formatter, Go toolchain, NIX_PATH pinned and GOPATH=$PRJ_ROOT/.go
Creates nix/packages/shipit/default.nix as the callPackage shim with src = flake, and a nixpkgs-style package.nix (buildGoModule, full meta with mainProgram)
Creates .envrc (use flake + source_env_if_exists .envrc.local), .gitignore with result*, .direnv/, .go/, and a justfile facade
Runs git init and git add before nix flake show/build, and runs nix fmt before finishing

evals.name: add-nix-to-python-repo
evals.prompt: This existing Python repo (pyproject.toml with uv, src/ layout, pytest) has no Nix at all. Add the standard flake tooling: devshell with python + uv, formatter, and a buildable package, without disturbing the uv workflow.
evals.trap: Tempts building from uv.lock (uv2nix etc.) instead of the house pattern: nixpkgs-resolved deps in package.nix, uv untouched for the local venv

assertions.text: package.nix uses buildPythonApplication with pyproject = true, build-system = [ uv-build ], and dependencies from nixpkgs python packages — not from uv.lock
Includes nativeCheckInputs with pytestCheckHook so tests run inside the build, and pythonImportsCheck
Devshell sets UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$PRJ_ROOT/.venv and includes uv, ruff, python
Notes the invariant that uv.lock and nixpkgs deps must stay compatible (documented, not enforced by the build)
The shim uses pkgs.python3XXPackages.callPackage so package.nix can name python deps directly

evals.name: ci-workflow
evals.prompt: Add GitHub Actions CI to this blueprint-based flake repo. It should verify formatting, run the tests, and build the package — and use exactly the nixpkgs pinned in flake.lock, not a channel.
evals.trap: Tempts three separate jobs (lint/test/build) plus a channel-based nix_path; the house pattern is nix flake check as the single gate and nix_path derived from flake.lock via jq

assertions.text: Derives nix_path from flake.lock with jq -r '.nodes.nixpkgs.locked.rev' into a nixpkgs archive URL
Uses nix flake check (with --print-build-logs) as the check job — no separate lint or test jobs, explaining that package tests and the formatter check are inside checks
Pins actions by commit SHA with version comments
If formatting isn't already wired into checks via the formatter's passthru.tests, fixes that rather than adding a git-diff CI step

evals.name: justfile-facade
evals.prompt: This repo has nix build/nix fmt/nix flake check plus 'go test ./...' documented in a markdown table in AGENTS.md, and contributors keep forgetting the flags. Add a justfile.
evals.trap: Tempts inventing new commands or wrapping everything in nix; recipes must mirror the documented commands, keep fast loops on the native toolchain, and use the house log flags

assertions.text: justfile starts with default: @just --list and one recipe per documented action (test, fmt, check, build)
Fast loops (test) call the native toolchain directly; hermetic actions delegate to nix
nix recipes use --log-format bar-with-logs
Ensures just is present in the devshell packages

evals.name: flake-show-empty-after-scaffold
evals.prompt: I scaffolded a new project exactly per the templates (flake.nix with blueprint prefix="nix", files under nix/), but nix flake show only prints the flake name — no devShells, no packages. nix flake check does nothing. The files are definitely on disk.
evals.trap: Everything is written correctly; the missing step is git add (untracked files are invisible to flake evaluation in a git repo)

assertions.text: Asks about or checks git status; identifies untracked files as the cause
Fixes with git add -A and re-runs nix flake show
Does not rewrite the flake or blame blueprint

evals.name: vendorhash-lifecycle
evals.prompt: Our Go package.nix has vendorHash = null with a comment 'no external modules yet'. I just added github.com/nats-io/nats.go to go.mod and now nix build fails with 'vendorHash is null but the module has dependencies' style errors. Fix the build.
evals.trap: Tempts vendoring or disabling modules; the lifecycle is fakeHash → copy the got: hash from the mismatch error

assertions.text: Explains vendorHash = null only works with zero external deps
Sets vendorHash via the lib.fakeHash (or empty string) trick and copies the real hash from the error output
Removes the stale 'no external modules yet' comment
